claim: Micron's CHIPS commercial-fab award was increased by US$275 million to US$6.44 billion on 12 June 2025 (superseding the US$6.165 billion listed as of 31 January 2025).
evidence: "a. Award for Micron was increased by $275 million to $6.44 billion on June 12, 2025." (CRS R49031, Table A-1 note a)

metric.name: CHIPS direct funding award, Micron
metric.population: Micron CHIPS commercial-fab incentive award (total incentives; no loans)
metric.methodology: CRS compilation of NIST CHIPS for America awards page

claim: After Micron's additional US$275 million award in June 2025, total CHIPS incentives-program direct funding awarded for commercial fabs was about US$30.9 billion, alongside US$5.5 billion in loans (excluding the US$3.0 billion Secure Enclave).
evidence: "This additional award brought the total direct funding awarded by the CHIPS incentives program to date to $30.9 billion, alongside $5.5 billion in loans." (CRS R49031, note 29)

metric.name: CHIPS incentives direct funding awarded (commercial fabs)
metric.population: CHIPS incentives program direct-funding awards, excluding Secure Enclave and loans
metric.methodology: CRS citing NIST announcement of 12 June 2025

notes: Adding the US$3.0bn Secure Enclave gives about US$33.9bn of CPO direct funding; that sum is arithmetic, not stated by the source.
